Container.Name: Stackyard
Container.Overview: A self-hosted homelab dashboard you actually want to look at.[br][br]Most dashboards are a wall of numbers and charts. Stackyard is the opposite: a calm, launcher-style grid of app tiles, folders, and a small number of genuinely useful widgets. Built to be glanced at a hundred times a day without feeling cluttered.[br][br]Everything is set up from the browser. Add app tiles, group them into folders, arrange pages, and drop in widgets for the services you already run. Widgets cover Docker, system health, downloads, media, backups, network and more.[br][br]Runs as one container with no external database and no runtime dependencies. Configuration and uploaded icons persist in the two paths below.[br][br]Note: most homelab services live on private addresses. The Allow Private IPs setting below is on by default so links and widgets pointing at your other containers work. Turn it off to keep the SSRF guard enabled.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: homelab dashboard homepage self-hosted launcher start page widgets
Container.DonateText: If Stackyard is useful to you, you can buy me a coffee.
Container.Changes:
### 1.23.0 - 2026-11-15
### Added
- Add a Reduce Transparency switch for this device under Appearance.
- Connections map: a failed service shows what kind of failure it is, and pressing it shows the full reason.
### Changed
- Restyle the dock, folders, search pill, page dots and Settings header buttons as clear glass with a lit rim.
- Draw the glass with refraction at its edges where the browser supports WebGL2.
- Show held switch and brightness knobs as clear glass lenses.
- Show translucent widget cards as glass over the wallpaper.
- Refuse to start when `ICONS_PATH` or `CONFIG_PATH` is not an absolute path, has a `.` or `..` part, sits inside a system folder such as `/etc` or `/usr`, or would put the config file inside `ICONS_PATH`. `ICONS_PATH` must use plain path characters. A folder below `/var`, `/tmp`, `/root` or `/app` is accepted only on a mounted volume.
### Fixed
- Enable Save after uploading a wallpaper or fetching an Image URL, including when it finishes during a save.
- Make the Connections VPN Off state and its light-theme error text readable.
- Show "Key rejected" or "Not set up yet" on the Connections widget instead of "Service error".
- A colour code typed in a colour field, or a preset colour picked, is now saved exactly instead of as a slightly different shade.
- A failed folder save no longer leaves an app missing from the folder it was in.
- After a drag with the mouse, the item list redraws at once, and clicking a row always opens that item.
- The sign-in password field is empty when the sign-in box appears again after a session expires.
- The Connections VPN view now draws the map for every country the Map view shows, including Switzerland, Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Austria and Belgium.
- A Connections VPN colour with an alpha value or in short form now shows as picked.
- Book spine titles stay readable on every cover colour from the reading service.
- Swiping between pages on a Backup card no longer flips the card or opens the backup service.
- Tapping a Backup card closes revealed cards in other widgets, as Disk Health does.
- After the Backup widget recovers from an error, empty slots no longer announce the old error or show a dash.
- On a phone, the page dots, arrow keys and screen-reader page control no longer land on an empty page after the number of home pages drops.
- A folder opened from Search on a phone shows its icons at the same size as when opened from its tile.
- Icons inside a desktop folder have the same rounded corners as on the home grid.
- A layout that fails to build shows one error screen instead of stacking a new one on each rotation or resize.
- The Fetch button in a widget's settings asks you to sign in again when the session has expired, instead of showing an error.
- A select field's Fetch button shows the widget's own button label.
- The pencil on widget setting rows follows the chosen icon style.
- A failed Docker label import offers Open General when no Docker socket address is set.
- Every password screen gives the same message when the server refuses a new password as too short or too long.
- Turning off Authentication on an app's Live Activity now removes the stored sign-in, query parameters and headers on save, and Fetch sends none of them.
- An app with a health check address from an older release now shows its health badge and Health pill.
- The digital and Captain clocks turn the minute on time instead of up to a second late.
- The analog clock, Connections map, Now Playing and Captain clock stop moving as soon as Reduce Motion is turned on.
- A dashboard or name containing a dollar sign shows correctly in widget labels.
- System Summary, Downloads and Disk Health show sizes and transfer rates in the same decimal units, with unit names in the reader's language.
- The GitHub contributions grid shows a new day's contributions after midnight, and the grid matches the total.
- Show a running Duplicati job as running on its own card instead of another job's card.
- Stop one failed Duplicati job from turning every Duplicati card red.
- Show a Duplicati sync job's own last run time, and use it for the error and missed checks.
- Show a missing or removed disabled Unraid drive as failed in Disk Health and count it among the failed bays.
- Fix System Summary and Network widgets set to Glances failing with "The service sent a reply that is not JSON."
- Show the real network rate from Glances 3 instead of 0 B/s.
- Leave no broken file behind when an icon or wallpaper upload fails on a full or read-only disk, and say why it failed.
- Save an icon uploaded as ".svg" under a proper name so it appears in the icon list.
- Save an icon with the extension that matches its contents.
- Refuse an icon named .svg that contains no SVG image.
- Save upload names with accented or non-Latin letters correctly, without control characters.
- Accept a wallpaper up to the 16 MB limit.
- Show a readable error when a request is too large for the web server.
- Stop requests to a service by name from timing out when the DNS server never answers IPv6 lookups.
- Send the query string of a status check URL, so a check such as `/status?check=db` reaches the right endpoint.
- Reuse one Pi-hole sign-in until it expires, so a slow Pi-hole no longer collects open sessions until it refuses the widget.
- Limit how many servers widgets remember details for, so previews against many addresses no longer grow memory without limit.
- Serve uploaded icons, wallpapers and the custom favicon from `ICONS_PATH`; before, they were saved but returned 404. With `ICONS_PATH=/data/icons`, one volume at `/data` keeps them across updates.
- Take ownership, on a root start, of the folders `CONFIG_PATH` and `ICONS_PATH` name, and create them when missing.
- Keep the saved settings of a widget whose type is not installed when Host IP, the port map or the certificate skip changes; its saved credentials must be retyped before they are used.
- With reduced motion, Settings and loading fades no longer cut instantly.
- Scrolling over a Settings dialog or the sign-in screen no longer scrolls the page behind it.
- Return no longer commits half-composed IME text in rename, text prompts and icon search.
- An empty sign-in asks for the password and no longer counts toward the lockout.
- The sign-in error is announced with the password field, which is marked invalid only for a wrong password.
- System Summary writes uptime and link speed units in the interface language.
- Downloads no longer shows Latin unit letters in Persian time estimates.
- Screen readers announce toggles as switches and slider values with their units.
- Settings group and dialog titles are real headings.
- The phone search pill is a button.
- The glass ring on a held switch and the lens on a held slider no longer look jagged on standard-resolution screens.
- The colour sliders now show the glass edges on a held knob, tinted from the colour under it.
### Security
- Update Node.js to 26.13.1 to fix 16 CVEs, 7 of them rated high.
- Pages no longer send their address to wallpaper and icon hosts.
- Add opener, resource and stricter content security policies.
- Widget pages refuse plugins and form submissions.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is reached on.

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Dashboard configuration. Keep this, or every setting is lost on update.

Config.Name: Icon Storage
Config.Description: Icons you upload for your app tiles.

Config.Name: Allow Private IPs
Config.Description: Let widgets and badges reach private addresses, which most homelab services use. Set to false to keep the SSRF guard on.

Config.Name: Docker Socket Proxy URL
Config.Description: Optional. Address of a Docker socket proxy, for the Docker widgets. Example: http://socket-proxy:2375

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Optional. Set to true behind a reverse proxy that terminates HTTPS, so the sign-in cookie is marked HTTPS-only.

Config.Name: Node Options
Config.Description: Node heap cap. Keep it near half the --memory limit in Extra Parameters, and raise both together.
